:::writing{variant="social_post" id="51842"}
Tonight was Franklin Classical School’s Night of Blessing, and what a truly beautiful and emotional evening it was for our family.

As we reflect on the last 8 years at this incredible classical school, our hearts are overflowing with gratitude. Franklin Classical has been so much more than a school to us. It has been a place of intentional discipleship, wisdom, virtue, integrity, humility, excellence, and Christ-centered education.

Tonight’s Night of Blessing so perfectly reflected the heart of this school. The love, prayer, encouragement, and intentional dedication poured into these seniors was incredibly moving to witness. Each student was spoken over with such purpose, truth, and care, reminding all of us how deeply valued and known they are.

To every faculty member, administrator, and staff member: thank you. Thank you for the countless hours, prayers, sacrifices, guidance, and love you have invested into our children over the years. Thank you for teaching them not only academically, but how to walk in faith, character, discipline, compassion, and leadership.

You have helped shape these students into young men and women who are prepared not only for the next chapter of life, but to serve Christ boldly within it.

We will miss each and every one of you more than words can express. Franklin Classical School will forever hold a sacred place in our hearts, and we are beyond grateful for the memories, friendships, and foundation this community has given our family.

What a gift these years have been. ❤️
:::

:::writing{variant="social_post" id="48271"}
Last night at Franklin Classical School was such a beautiful blessing for our family. As we close this chapter, my heart is overflowing with gratitude for the last 8 years we have spent within these walls.

This school has been so much more than academics. It has been a place of intentional discipleship, wisdom, virtue, integrity, excellence, and Christ-centered leadership. Every faculty member has poured so much love, prayer, encouragement, patience, and dedication into our children, helping shape not only their education, but their character and faith.

To the teachers, administrators, and staff: thank you for investing countless hours into raising up young men and women to be thoughtful, compassionate, disciplined, and deeply rooted in Christ. Your impact reaches far beyond the classroom, and it will stay with our family forever.

Watching the seniors celebrated with such prayerful intention and heartfelt encouragement last night was incredibly moving. What a gift it is to be surrounded by a community that truly sees each child as uniquely created with purpose and calling.

We will deeply miss each and every one of you. Franklin Classical will always hold such a special place in our hearts, and we are forever grateful for the love, friendships, memories, and foundation this school has given our family.

What a beautiful season it has been. ❤️
:::
